shortDescription: Associated British Foods LSE:ABF said on Thursday its Primark clothing business, which it plans to spin off next year, will offer home delivery in the UK in the future.The group said Primark's like-for-like sales are expected to be down 3.0% in its fourth quarter to September 12.
